import sys

def run():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    a = [next(it) for _ in range(n)]
    t = next(it)
    a.sort()
    i = -1
    j = 0
    mx = 0
    while j < n:
        i += 1
        while j < n and a[j] - a[i] <= t:
            j += 1
        mx = max(mx, j - i)
    print(mx)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
